book.name: EFESUS
book.title: Pol nember tup nal lenge Efesus

content: Poi Kristen pe, poi wahriꞌ ilyeh tikin Krais
Ŋam Pol, ŋam marp mwahupwaiꞌe. Detale, ŋam mende wah tikin Lahmborenge. Pe ŋam da mini yip ŋaiye pa yurp junde wusyep ŋaiye Got si gal yip.

Pa syumbe yurp ŋumwaiye, topoꞌe yukur pa yende wachaih yilme lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yende wachaihme yip. Pa yasambe ŋoihmbwaip yip ŋaiye yende niharar yil lenge mitiŋ, kut yukur pa ŋoiheryembe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe pupwa ŋaiye tinge yende me yip.
Yohe Yirise ki yal yip ŋoihmbwaip ilyeh pe, pa yende wah nihe ŋaiye pa yurp juhilyeh topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye.
Wahriꞌ poi kin ŋaisep ilyeh, topoꞌe Yohe Yirise, kin ŋaisep ŋilyeh. Taꞌe luku pe, Got si nambaꞌ yip ŋaiye pa yurp yeseperhme ŋaimune bwore bwore ŋaiye ka ot.
Lahmborenge ŋaisep ilyeh ŋaiye kin narp, topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip poi ŋaiye teŋeime kin ŋilyeh, topoꞌe ŋaiye yambaꞌe pinip ki ŋilyeh.
Got kin ŋilyeh, topoꞌe Yai lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme. Kin Lahmborenge poi lalme. Kin ŋilyeh ŋaiye ŋende wah gah bumbe poi lalme. Topoꞌe kin narp nato poi lalme.
Taꞌe luku pe, Krais kin ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me poi pe, kin pwal poi yitini tikin Yohe Yirise ilyeh ilyeh tongonose gande ŋasande kitikin.
Ki taꞌe ŋaiye wusyep tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: Ŋupe ŋaiye kin nanah hlaꞌ supule pe,
kin nambaꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wula wula
ŋaiye yarp mwahupwaiꞌe yal yotop kin.
Pe kin nangange yitini nal lenge mitiŋ uku.

content: Wusyep uku pe, ki nanah hlaꞌ supule me ŋaimune? Tehei kin taꞌe leꞌe, ŋendeheiyeh kin pe, kin nate gah kekep eꞌe.
Taꞌe luku pe, kin miyeꞌ esep ilyeh uku ŋaiye nate gah kekep pe, kin ilyeh uku ki plihe nanah moihlaꞌ supule. Kin ka aparaꞌe kekep topoꞌe moihlaꞌ lalme.

Pe kin ilyeh uku nangange yitini nal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin. Kin nalaŋatme mitiŋ syeꞌ taꞌe aposel, syeꞌ taꞌe profet. O syeꞌ taꞌe lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye yanange yalaŋatme wusyep bwore mise tikin Got yalꞌe yalꞌe taꞌe evangelis. Topoꞌe kin nalaŋatme mitiŋ syeꞌ taꞌe pasto, topoꞌe syeꞌ taꞌe jetmam.
Krais ŋende ŋai uku ŋaiye ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got ŋaiye ka yende wah kin bworerme. Pe ka ende bongolme sios ŋaiye wahriꞌ tikin Krais miꞌe pe, ka eŋelꞌe enge el.
Ŋupe ŋaiye ya lalme mute guhilyeh no, ŋoihmbwaip poi ka el ŋilyeh pe, ya sisyeme Krais, Talah tikin Got. Taꞌe luku pe, poi lenge Kristen ya mambaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore tuꞌe Krais.

Kut poi yukur ya murp tuꞌe ŋaiye lenge lahmakerep. Ya bunjenge musme ŋoihmbwaip hoi hoi poi ŋaiye teŋeime wusyep lenge miyeꞌ homboꞌe. Somohon ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende nate ŋanange wusyep ŋoinde tikin homboꞌe paŋaih poi pe, poi manange wusyep uku ki bwore mise pe, poi gwande.
Kom tukwini poi ya mende niharar lenge mitiŋ pe, ya mininge wusyep ŋaiye ki bwore mise ŋilyehme. Poi ya mi tongorꞌ mil topoꞌe Krais pe, Krais kin ŋondoh me poi lalme.

Gande ŋasande kitikin pe, wahriꞌ uku kin neŋelꞌe lalme nal ŋilyeh bwore miꞌ supule. Wahriꞌ poi lalme pe, tinge yende wah tititinge ilyeh ilyeh tongonose. Ki nungwisme wahriꞌ lalme tahar bongol. Wahriꞌ orope lalme luku tahar ŋembere bongol bwore miꞌ supule pe, ki paparar me ŋoihmbwaip ŋaiye ŋende niharar lenge mitiŋ.
Lenge Kristen miyeꞌ tuweinge ka junde ŋoihmbwaip ŋambaran

Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam de ma mini yip wusyep bongol ende tuꞌe leꞌe. Nato naŋ tikin Lahmborenge pe, yukur pa yurp tuꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin kekep eꞌe ŋaiye yukur sisyeme Got. Ŋoihmbwaip topoꞌe ŋoiheryembe tinge si hoi hoi.
Ŋoiheryembe tinge tikin yepelmbe supule, topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tinge si tingis. Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yarp ya tas wicherꞌ me laip bwore tikin Got.

Tinge yukur ka se hiꞌ me ŋaimune ŋaiye tinge yende nange luku ki bwore lakai pupwa. Tinge behembuhu yende. Tinge yal yoto yende hwap tetehei ŋaiye tikin pupwa yehe supule tikin kekep eꞌe ŋaiye tinge ŋoiheryembe ka yende. Ka yende niŋ pinip yar, topoꞌme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe pupwa yenge yal.
Kom ŋupe ŋaiye yip yisande wusyep tikin Krais pe, yukur tinge yalaŋat yip ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe pupwa luku ŋaiye pa yende topoꞌe, pakai.
Tinge si yalaŋat yip wusyep mise ŋaiye sai nato Jisas, topoꞌe yip si yisande wusyep kin.
Taꞌe luku pe, yember ŋaimun pupwa pupwa ŋaiye somohon yip yende liki yil tikihe. Jinyenme ŋoihmbwaip yerkeime pupwa yehe supule ŋaiye kete yip nenge nal ŋahwikin pupwa.
Ŋoiheryembe topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip yip ka si bwore ŋambaran supule.
Got ŋende yip ŋambaran, ŋahilyeh taꞌe kitikin pe, pa yurp bwore bwarme junde yaŋah mise tikin Got.
Yip pa yusme ŋaiye yininge wusyep homboꞌe. Yip pa yininge wusyep mise ilyehme yil lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge. Detale, poi ilyeh ilyeh, poi wahriꞌ tikin Krais.
Topoꞌe ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip yip ka nihe pe, yukur pa yusme ŋoihmbwaip nihe yip uku ka enge yip e oto hwap. Topoꞌe yukur pa yurpe tuhwar yip uku yenge si yi tutume ŋaiye ŋau ka e guh.
Yukur pa chumbur kohmap me Satan.

Lahmende ŋaiye kin ŋende ŋendei pe, sekei no. Kin ka enge syep kin hoime luku ende wah ŋaiye bwore pe, ka se ambaꞌe ŋaimune ŋaiye kin seheiꞌe. Topoꞌe ka aŋaꞌe lahmende ŋaiye tinge seheiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe.
Yip yukur pa yininge wusyep tetehei pupwa tus mut yip, na pakai. Yininge wusyep ŋaiye ki bwore ŋilyehme. Wusyep bwore yip uku ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got ŋaiye ka yurp bwore bwarme.
Topoꞌe yip yukur pa yaŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip mane yilme Yohe Yirise, kin wutuꞌ tikin Got ŋaiye narp nato yip. Topoꞌe kin nalaŋatme ŋup tikin Got ŋaiye ka ambaꞌe yip no, pa yurp hlaininge.
Yip pa jinyenme ŋoihmbwaip pupwa, ŋoihmbwaip syohe, ŋoihmbwaip nihe, wusyep pupwa, wusyep hiꞌe, topoꞌe ŋoiheryembe pupwa ŋaiye na ende yumbune miyeꞌ ende.
Pa yasambe ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore yil lenge Kristen miyeꞌ tuweinge. Pa yusme pupwa lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tuꞌe ŋaiye Got nasme pupwa yip nato naŋ tikin Krais.
